brief:
Israel continues near-daily attacks across Gaza and occupies roughly two-thirds of the enclave a year after President Donald Trump proposed an end to the war, according to Al-Monitor. Palestinians in the territory face dire humanitarian conditions amid the ongoing military operations.

The plan has not achieved its stated objectives of stopping Israeli fire or disarming Hamas, leaving the conflict substantially unresolved.
dek: JERUSALEM, Oct 6 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump’s year-old plan to end the Gaza war has stalled, with Israel mounting near daily attacks and occupying around two-thirds of the shattered enclave where Palestinians face dire conditions.
title: Trump's Gaza plan fails to halt Israeli operations after one year
